sources.title: NVIDIA Announces Financial Results for Second Quarter Fiscal 2027

growing.note: Q2 fiscal 2027 revenue was $96.2 billion, up 106% year over year; Data Center revenue was $89.0 billion, up 117%.

moat.note: The disclosure describes a broad accelerated-computing platform spanning GPUs, CPUs, networking, software libraries, and AI-factory systems.

management.note: The board announced a CEO transition with Colette Kress serving as interim CEO and CFO; continuity was asserted but the leadership change adds execution uncertainty.

margins.note: Q2 fiscal 2027 GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins were both 75.0%, versus 72.4% and 72.5% a year earlier.

cash.note: The Q2 disclosure reports approximately $26.0 billion returned through repurchases and dividends and approximately $99.0 billion remaining under the repurchase authorization; a complete operating-cash-flow reconciliation was not reviewed.

risk.note: The Q2 10-Q notes that China shipments of Data Center Hopper products were less than 1% of Data Center revenue, evidencing export-control exposure even though reported exposure was limited in that quarter.
